pages.title: A tribe's way, lent to you
text: Every tribe has a **boon**: a small perk in that tribe's way of doing things, shown as a status effect in the tribe's colour.

Reach **Kin** standing with a tribe and you carry its boon for as long as the standing lasts. It refreshes on its own; you never have to ask. Anyone can carry a boon for a while by eating that tribe's [dish](tribe_dishes).
A worn **Lantern charm** keeps a boon lit half again as long.
- **Soil (Pad-keepers)**: your fields are never trampled, and hunger comes slower.
- **Stone (Grit-singers)**: ore you break has a **one in five** chance to give one more.
- **Sprout (Rootbinders)**: crops and saplings within 4 blocks grow faster around you.
- **Claw (Edge-walkers)**: no fall hurts you while you **sneak**.
- **Spark (Drumhearts)**: a quicker hand: you swing **10%** faster.
pages.title: The nine boons

text: - **Clock (Pattern-weavers)**: Echo stations within 8 blocks of you work at **double speed**.
- **Spindle (Loom-stitchers)**: songs cost **a quarter less** to sing.
Every number is in the `effects` section of the common config.
